title: Sympatec GmbH
content: Sympatec GmbH is a German supplier of particle size and shape analyzers for powders, suspensions, aerosols, and sprays. These measurement capabilities are relevant to aerogel feedstock, granule, and powder characterization in both development and quality-control settings. Sympatec fits the Equipment Materials category as an upstream instrumentation vendor for particle-centric materials workflows.
review_notes: Directory profile reviewed for listing quality, category fit, and current public website availability.
